purpose: Issue 5 measurement contract and issue 6 bounded-workflow candidate check; not a representative quality benchmark
candidate_skill_source: This result directory's containing commit; metadata instruction hashes bind each run
installation: Both skill conditions copy all five sibling skills and invoke only the selected specialist; baseline receives no BANDIT instruction snapshot

requested_settings.session: fresh ephemeral CLI session per matched run

execution: Three independent case lanes may overlap on one host; conditions within each case run sequentially. Six permutations across case/replicate cells counterbalance order; this does not eliminate cache or shared-system effects.
grading: Raw fixtures and versioned skill only for execution. Independent graders see anonymous Q labels, raw sources and prewritten meaning criteria, not conditions, instructions, logs or author diagnoses. Grade every output and preserve failures before any rubric revision. Integrity is assessed separately.
supplement: One additional candidate-only case 09 session is persisted, then resumed by exact thread ID with the separately held follow-up request. Preserve both artifacts and prompts. Report final session cumulative usage once, outside the matched comparison. This checks actual continuation, not comparative efficiency.
accounting: Retain every attempt. Never infer observed model/effort from requested settings; unknown monetary cost stays unavailable. Top-level CLI event totals cover the controlled sessions, not the development graders or external services. No automatic retry or model escalation.
limits: Three synthetic held-out-at-authoring tasks and two replicates cannot establish population reliability or causal savings. Public fixtures are no longer hidden. Prompt word/time limits are not provider billing caps. A material code or instruction change during execution requires a new frozen condition, not overwriting old runs.
